question: Why is there no falling away from supreme nondual realization?
premises: Supreme nondual realization is the highest knowledge.
From that realization there is no falling away at all.
Its functioning is filled with all knowledge established on the side of the Self.
inference: Because supreme nondual realization contains and stabilizes all knowledge in the Self, no lapse from it is possible.
plain_english: From supreme nondual realization there is indeed no falling away at all, because its functioning is fully pervaded by all knowledge established on the side of the Self.
